To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the average size of an ontology module extracted from a set of terms is 10.5%, (2) the average size is 11.5% when the set of terms includes the root term of the ontology, (3) the average size increases to 12.6% when the set includes the root term and the root term's children, and (4) the average size decreases to 9% when the set excludes the root term.
• The modular structure of a given ontology is highly dependent on the set of terms used to extract the modules from that ontology.
